card.name: Inside longer words after a stem
card.fires_on: Word endings that complete a longer word after a stem such as coll, poll, refr, mor or comp. Seen most in cross-pollination, refraining, colluding and co-morbid.

modes.label: Cross-pollination
modes.description: The ending of pollinate or pollination after cross-poll in plant breeding text.
modes.example: cross-poll<<ination>> is an invaluable method in breeding

modes.label: Refrain and collude
modes.description: The ending of verbs like refrain or collude after a short stem.
modes.example: Athanasius refr<<ained>> from vilifying his opponents

modes.label: Co-morbid and complicit
modes.description: The ending of co-morbid or complicit after a short stem.
modes.example: depression or anxiety co-mor<<bid>> with substance use disorders
